text:
maria (Partnerships PM): quick sync — HW SI partner (EdgeRetail) wants us to list an open 7B model on a cloud marketplace bundle with their appliance and co-announce. main asks: redistribution rights for quantized weights, dual-listing on partner marketplace, embargo date, and SLA for inference support. who should own legal + tech checks?

devin (Legal): high level concerns: need the model license text and any contributor CLA. key checklist: rehosting rights, commercial use, modification & redistribution, attribution, and indemnity carveouts. also confirm export control (EAR/OFAC) for the model and any training data flags. timeline: can do initial review in ~10 business days if we get the license link + repo. :eyes:

sam (Solutions Eng): tech notes: 1) quantify: can partner ship quantized weights? some licenses prohibit derivative redistribution — need explicit rehost permission. 2) for marketplace hosting we require signed checksum + provenance manifest (sha256 + modelcard). 3) packaging snippet for staging test: `./packager --model ./weights --quantize q4_0 --manifest manifest.yaml --sign-key /keys/marketplace.pem` — this will produce the .rtm bundle marketplace expects. also need to confirm if the HW vendor requires our adapter plugin for the appliance (likely yes).

jordan (Product): sequencing POV: prefer canary listing on our staging marketplace, internal beta with partner customers, then joint announce. marketing needs 2 weeks for assets and co-branded comms. if legal slips, we should decouple the product listing from public PR so marketplace listing can go live earlier.

devin (Legal): +1 on decoupling. also: if partner wants us to host their copy, require indemnity + export attestation from them. request they complete a model provenance form (I can share template). vendor must explicitly permit distribution of quantized/converted copies. without that, we only point to a partner-hosted download and block direct hosting.

maria (Partnerships PM): action items I propose: 1) sam to run a packaging dry-run against staging by EOD Fri; 2) devin sends provenance template & legal checklist to partner; 3) jordan to draft a tentative co-announce timeline (internal) by Tue. target soft-listing date: 2024-10-01 (canary), public PR: 2024-10-15. owners: sam/devin/jordan respectively. anyone object? :thumbsup:

announce-bot: Reminder: create marketplace listing task P-482 and tag #partner-onboard by 2024-09-08.

sam (Solutions Eng): ack, will try packaging dry-run in staging. will paste logs in thread if any blockers. also flagging: need partner S3 credentials + signed EULA before we can ingest weights.

devin (Legal): I will send the provenance + indemnity draft now. if partner pushes for faster announce, we can offer a timeline contingency: listing locked behind KMS + restricted access until legal sign-off.

maria (Partnerships PM): perfect — thanks all. i'll ping partner after devin shares docs and set up a 30m sync for Tuesday.

jordan (Product): noted. prepping marketing checklist. if legal approves earlier we'll accelerate PR. :rocket:
